o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *kayïna-, a derivation of Proto-Common Turkic *kań, *kïń.
Ultimately from Arabic مَأْذُونِيَّة (maʔḏūniyya). Cognate with Turkish mezuniyet.
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *püskür- (“to spurt, splutter”). Onomatopoeic in the older root form püf or püs. By surface analysis, püs (“blowing and spurting sound”) + -kür. Compare Turkish püskürmek.
